resources.string: Build your one-on-one game: handles, pace and confident finishes.
Keep building consistency with repeat sessions, skill checks and live games against different players.

Begin with two court sessions a week, adding a third when recovery is comfortable. Leave an easy day between demanding court sessions and count pickup games as training. On calisthenics days, keep court work short and technical; reduce leg work when tired. Repeat sessions until control is consistent. Attempt counts are ceilings, not make-until-finished targets. Walk to recover and take longer rests when needed.
Check each target after meeting it on two different days. These are practice goals, not a certification. Repeat earlier sessions as needed. Solo rehearsals do not replace the live-player checks.

PICKUP
Agree on scoring, winning score, fouls, clearing, checking and who keeps possession after a basket before playing. Call fouls calmly, respect the call and share the court.

FIBA 3x3
Shots inside the arc and free throws count 1; shots outside count 2. Regulation lasts 10 minutes or ends when a team reaches 21. A possession has 12 seconds. After a defensive rebound or steal, clear the ball beyond the arc. After a made basket, the non-scoring team takes the ball from under the hoop and clears it; there is no check after each basket. Dead-ball restarts use a check at the top. In overtime, the first team to score 2 wins.

Local pickup rules vary. FIBA rules: about.fiba.basketball/en/our-sport/3x3-basketball
